## Change and reason

Describe the result, why it is needed and the scope that remains unchanged.

## Verification

List the repository revision, checks actually performed and their results. At this stage no executable test suite exists; for documentation, check links, accuracy and privacy. Identify any checks not run.

## Compatibility and risks

Explain affected contracts, third-party material, documentation updates and remaining limitations. Do not include real profiles or conversation logs.

- [ ] The change is focused and matches the planning-stage status.
- [ ] I checked links and factual claims, and disclosed skipped checks.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private configuration or session content is included.
- [ ] Incorporated material is compatible with MIT and preserves required notices.
